race.comment: RICH LADY (15) is the horse to beat after being beaten a nose at this track when held up near the 300m, then picking up impressively once clear. She has a strong placing profile at this track and distance and gets Jake Toeroek back on, so the last-start form makes her a major player. EXTRA FLING (3) resumes with a trial win behind him and has never missed the quinella, including a dominant Strathalbyn Maiden win before the break. Everything points towards a big run. REOFFER (14) is hard fit, was close up at Mildura in a BM62, and her previous placing at this venue ties her in strongly. Include. NOSTRYIA (1) solid BM62 placing at Jamestown and placed in all four track-and-distance runs. Include in wider plays.
